name: Quest Twilight Prince Prophecy Chronicles
source:
Her name is Donna. Just a normal girl, actually. 

Except that... she is the Messiah. 

Twilight Prince's Prophecy Quest Chronicles is an epic otome game detailing a lone girl's journey into the wilderness of magic, mystery and intrigue. This game has full voice acting which truly brings these characters to life, so what are you waiting for? Be wowed by the seven wonders through your journey - will you find love? Will you save this world, and everyone who desperately wishes for your help?

FEATURES:
* FULL voice acting - thanks to AxemRed, Kirroha, wakagana and many more!
* A beautiful, deep cast of characters!
* A strong, solid story!
* Hours of fun and adventure!
* A 100MB filesize, unfortunately, but I assure you that it will be worth it!
* music and picturs from google, and lovely comic sans text

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18134]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
她的名字叫唐娜。其实只是一个普通的女孩 

除此之外……她是弥赛亚。

《暮光王子的预言任务编年史》是一款史诗般的乙女游戏，详细描述了一个孤独女孩进入充满魔法、神秘和阴谋的荒野的旅程。这款游戏拥有完整的配音，真正将这些角色栩栩如生，所以你还在等什么？旅途中的七大奇迹让你惊叹不已 - 你会找到爱情吗？你会拯救这个世界，以及所有迫切需要你帮助的人吗？

特点：
* 全配音 - 感谢AxemRed、Kirroha、wakagana等！
* 美丽而深刻的角色阵容！
* 一个强大而扎实的故事！
* 数小时的乐趣和冒险！
* 不幸的是，文件大小为100MB，但我向你保证这是值得的！
* 音乐和图片来自谷歌，还有可爱的无文字漫画

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18134]引理软论坛[/url]]
